title: Cisco ISE operations
description: Keep network access control running. Follows the Cisco ISE system alarms: processes going down, nodes running out of CPU, memory or disk, replication between nodes failing, network devices rejecting Change of Authorization, and RADIUS authentication getting slow.

splunkbaseApps.displayName: Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services

requiredData.notes: Configure ISE remote logging targets to send the Monitoring, System Diagnostics, and RADIUS categories to a Splunk syslog input (or SC4S) with sourcetype cisco:ise:syslog, and install the Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services on the search head.

industrySources.control: Cisco ISE alarms: Process Down, High Load Average, High Memory/Disk Utilization, Replication Failed, CoA Failed, High Authentication Latency
ISE node replication alarms: causes and impact

curationNotes: Each step maps to an ISE system alarm so the Splunk search confirms what the ISE Alarms dashlet shows.
UC-17.1.56 also reads cisco:ios to correlate the switch side of a failed CoA; the ISE side works on its own.
